title: Co-op voice for all adventures: vox.bin, vox-igc.bin, vox-mp.bin, net.bin (u3fix.exe coop-voice2, coop-voice2/apply_coop_vox.cpp)
notes: Since 2026-11-13 C++ (u3fix.exe coop-voice2 = apply_coop_vox.py). On the reference vox.bin (which dc-recipes rebuilds) the step is a byte-exact no-op; from the retail vox.bin it adds the same 464 entries to the same size, the reference differing only in 42 bytes of old entries that an earlier session edited.
